Your whole club. In your pocket.

Search any member. See everything. Call them in one tap.

Every parent and gymnast in your club, searchable in seconds — by admins and coaches alike. Tap a name and see their full profile in one place: contact details, emergency contacts, medical conditions and allergies, and photo permissions.

No separate contacts list to dig through. Registers, sorted.

Full register history. Every class, every date, instantly.

Coaches take the register on their phone in seconds, and it saves automatically the moment it's marked — nothing to submit, nothing to lose. Filter by day or by class to see exactly who attended, who was late and how many sessions have run.

No more paper registers, no more asking a coach what happened three weeks ago. The full history is there, for every class, every time.

On the register itself.

Allergies, medical alerts and photo permission — right there on the register.

No flicking to another screen, no asking a parent to repeat themselves. Every child's card on the register shows medical alerts, medication, special requirements and photo permission instantly — coaches see everything they need before the session even starts.

Mark attendance with a single tap. It's all saved automatically, the moment it happens.

Our story

Built by a club parent, for club owners

Apps By Angela was built alongside the people who actually run clubs — coaches, administrators and club owners who told us exactly what they needed. What started as a solution for one gymnastics club grew into something much bigger.

Every single feature on the platform exists because a real club asked for it. Whether your members are juniors or adults, we listened, we built it, and we keep building — because club management should work the way clubs actually work.

Built independently and shaped by feedback from gymnastics clubs, Apps By Angela focuses on practical features that help clubs save time, improve communication and keep everything in one place. Every major feature has been developed in response to real feedback from club owners, coaches and parents — and the platform continues to evolve as clubs grow.

Safeguarding built in

No child ever misses their moment.

Photo consent is taken seriously. But it shouldn't mean a child misses out on being recognised for their hard work.

With Apps By Angela, if a child doesn't have photo permission, a default image is automatically used in their place. They still get recognised as Gymnast of the Month. The notification still goes out. Their achievement is still celebrated.

Every child. Every achievement. Always celebrated.

✓Photo consent tracked per child on the register
✓Default image used automatically if no consent given
✓Recognition notification still goes to all members
✓No child is ever excluded from their moment

You choose how your club takes payments. If you'd like to accept card payments too, Stripe is built in with no added markup, so every penny goes straight to your club. The choice is entirely yours.
Yes. Clubs can send parent updates and push notifications through their own branded club app, helping reduce missed messages and making communication feel more professional.
